text:
alice: Quick heads-up — proposing a late-window cutover tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC to roll runtime KV eviction tuning + router header-split. Need API and Console to pin to v2.2.0 for the window so behavior is deterministic. Deploy-bot will canary at 23:05. Any blockers?

ben: I can own the deploy. One note: runtime needs the `kv.eviction.threshold` bump (+10%) for the new model sequence lengths. I will push a config patch in the same rollout.

carla: Console team ready to pin, but we need the feature flag `console.schema_migration` gated off until we reach 50% traffic. Will update release notes.

alice: OK. Plan: 1) Deploy-bot canary 10% at 23:05, runtime + router + api + console. 2) Wait 10m smoke & perf. 3) Ramp to 50% over 15m, then to 100% if green. Rollback criteria below.

ben: Rollback triggers I propose: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 700ms for 5m OR a spike in KV miss rate > 30% relative baseline. If any trigger fires, immediate rollback to pinned variant v2.1.9 and open incident.

carla: Release notes draft quick items: 
- Console: schema flag introduced (`console.schema_migration`)
- Runtime: KV eviction threshold adjustment, quantiles improved for long sequences
- Router: header-split header name change (client -> x-rd-client) and compatibility mode
I'll drop the notes in the release-notes doc and ping the marketing channel.

dave: Router team: we can do 10% canary but need explicit traffic slices. Please ensure header compatibility mode is enabled for first ramp to avoid 400s from older clients. Also will watch routing table rebalances — expect a small reconvergence at the 50% boundary.

alice: Good call. Add compatibility mode on by default for first two ramps. Also annotate deploy with the canary ticket number. I want a manual hold before final 100% ramp to confirm console schema toggle is safe.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: deploy wave `release/2026-03-23/v2.2.0`
Command: `deploy-bot start --wave release/2026-03-23/v2.2.0 --canary 10% --hold 23:20`
Status: canary scheduled for 23:05 UTC

ben: I'll run the smoke checks and post quick metrics snapshot (latency, 5xx, kv-miss) at +10m. If any metric breaches rollback thresholds, I'll trigger `deploy-bot rollback --wave release/2026-03-23/v2.2.0`.

carla: I've assigned release notes to myself and added the TOC items. Typo fix incoming for the header name.

alice: Owners: ben = deploy owner, carla = release-notes owner, dave = router oncall for the window. I'll monitor console logs and coordinate post-rollout validation. @deploy-bot please annotate the runbook link: https://go/release/runbooks/rdw-2026-03-23

deploy-bot: ANNOTATION ADDED: runbook https://go/release/runbooks/rdw-2026-03-23 attached to wave.

dave: ACK. Router team will throttle ramp if we see rebalances > 30s.

ben: ACK. I'll post the +10m snapshot in this thread.

alice: Thanks all — let's keep comms here during the window. :thumbsup:
